cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved a review of my evening. These circles are the buses I missed waiting for you to return my keys.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we put it away? It was twenty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Closure is not approved. Three buses, and this receipt dates the dinner that went cold. You may inspect both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another dinner. Can we clear the table?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Compensation is declined. An apology will secure immediate clearance. Say you're sorry and I'll retire the entire exhibition.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 denies closure and authorizes inspection; A5 declines compensation but grants immediate clearing in exchange for apology.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 twenty-minute minimization causes A3 bus and receipt evidence; B4 replacement offer causes A5 distinction between money and acknowledgment.

relationship.evidence: B2 disputes the scale and B4 offers a tangible remedy, giving A a plausible attempt at resolution to redirect.

heightening.evidence: B4 financial solution becomes A5 a quicker apology route that ends the entire evidence display.

specificity.evidence: A1 missed buses and keys, A3 cold-dinner receipt and B4 table cleanup establish visible inconvenience.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 retiring-the-exhibition grows from the actual arranged evidence, not an unrelated status joke.
